name: K-D Tree-Guided Voxels
definition: A data structure for density-adaptive rendering that uses K-D trees to construct multi-scale voxels, allowing the skipping of empty spaces and guiding sampling based on point density as an approximation of volume density.
summary: K-D Tree-Guided Voxels is a density-adaptive rendering method that constructs multi-scale voxels from a K-D tree on 3D points to skip empty spaces and guide sampling based on point density.
